note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (Bookmark #8: Electric energy) lowercases every column and renames P04A08, P04A08A1..A4, P04A08B to e_p04a08, e_p04a08a1..e_p04a08a4, e_p04a08b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 89-94) labels each column, 6/6, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P04A08; P04A08A rows 1-4; P04A08B). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.4 (checked against the rendered page image at 250 dpi), not the dictionary labels: A1-A4 and B dictionary labels are character-identical to the questionnaire (5/5); dictionary label typo not shipped: P04A08 'esta conectado' (questionnaire 'está conectado'). Structure: P04A08 (connected to an electric grid yes/no) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P04A08A lead-in 'Durante el 2024, el servicio de energía eléctrica que recibe en su vivienda:' is shared by A1-A4 -> section_prompt of section _2; P04A08B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the skip instruction 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A09' not shipped. Options as printed: P04A08 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A4 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 'NS' (don't know) is kept as a response category on A1-A4 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A08B prints bare 1-10 bubbles (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' is set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Skip pattern: P04A08=2 (NO, 525 households) routes to P04A09; in the source xlsx exactly those 525 households are blank on all of A1-A4 and B, and all 6,361 P04A08=1 households are non-blank on all five; the do-file keeps the skipped rows with resp NULL. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 24/24 valid item x resp cells equal (p04a08 1/2 = 6361/525; a1 1/2/3 = 2939/3394/28; a2 3164/3104/93; a3 2440/3860/61; a4 177/6115/69; b 1..10 = 396/138/220/223/895/480/693/1180/608/1311) and NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a4 525 each, b 525+217=742. Live: 41,316 rows (= 6 x 6,886), 6,886 ids (= all Hogares rows), 41,316 distinct id-item, 2,842 NULL resp (6.9%). Rights: INE Guatemala is the originator; no licence and no stated reservation (bare copyright footer only); IRW's footing is the dictionary's 'Permission via Email'. Batch_627 orchestrator ruling for the family applies: SHIP under SKILL.md 'silence is still permission'. No instrument_rights_register.csv row. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project. Not to be confused with sibling guatemala_2024_homes_lighting (public street lighting), a different table.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of INE Guatemala's Spanish questionnaire; for items e_p04a08a1-a4, resp 3 is 'NS' (don't know), kept as a response category, and households not connected to an electric grid (e_p04a08 = 2) skipped e_p04a08a1-a4 and e_p04a08b, whose rows remain with resp NULL, as do 217 e_p04a08b rows answered 'no sabe / no responde' (code 98).
